authority: CON.43 (S61(1), S61(2)): registry 04 section 6 and its initial capability binding, contracts 02 DP-01 to DP-06; typed requests and results are materialized from the independent fixtures/public/wp03-01.json samples, and the structured form was derived independently of eng/local_operations.py.
notation: arguments and result: a JSON object is a record whose entries keep the written order, an array is a list, a string is text, true/false is boolean, an integer is integer and null is the null kind; the one-key objects $number, $instant, $decimal, $resource and $value carry a number, an Instant, a Decimal, a ResourceRef or a raw StructuredValue (protobuf JSON), and $record carries an ordered [key, value] entry list. request, value, meta and context are protobuf JSON.
